description: This is a PHPUnit test class for the ClaimRequestActionAPI in the OrangeHRM Claim plugin module. It contains test cases for updating claim request actions, as well as placeholders asserting that certain API methods are not implemented.

classes.name: ClaimRequestActionAPITest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for ClaimRequestActionAPI, testing the update functionality and verifying that delete and get methods are not implemented.

methods.name: setUpBeforeClass
methods.description: Initializes test data for the entire test class by populating workflow state machine data.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Tests the update API endpoint with various test case parameters.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestUpdate
methods.description: Provides test cases for the testUpdate method from a YAML fixture.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Confirms that the delete method of the API throws a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Confirms that the validation rule method for delete throws a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Confirms that the getOne method throws a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Confirms that the validation rule method for getOne throws a not implemented exception.
